meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 完成时间序列数据的分类、预测与异常识别
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有按时间顺序记录的数据,想预测走向或发现问题
copy.tagline_en: Build forecasting, classification and anomaly detection models on time-stamped data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have time-stamped data and want to forecast trends or spot unusual patterns.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Python 的 aeon 工具包处理时间序列数据，为分类、回归、预测等任务写出代码，并给出准确率、预测值、异常分数这类结果。
howto.when: 当你处理时间序列、序列模式等按时间索引的数据，要做分类、预测等任务且需要普通机器学习之外的专用算法时，它会接管。

say.text: 用 aeon 的 ROCKET 对这个时间序列数据集做分类
say.note: 会加载数据、训练分类器并报出准确率。

say.text: 用 STOMP 检测这段序列里的异常点
say.note: 输出每个时间点的异常分数。

say.text: 用 aeon 抽特征，再接到 sklearn 分类器上
say.note: 先生成 ROCKET 特征，再训练模型。

howto.what_en: Claude will use aeon, a Python toolkit for time series machine learning, to write code for classification, regression, forecasting and similar tasks, returning results such as accuracy, predictions or anomaly scores.
howto.when_en: Use when you work with time series, sequential patterns or time-indexed data and need specialized algorithms beyond standard ML, for tasks like classification or forecasting.

say_en.text: Use aeon's ROCKET to classify this time series dataset
say_en.note: Loads data, trains the classifier, reports accuracy.

say_en.text: Detect anomalies in this series with STOMP
say_en.note: Returns an anomaly score per time point.

say_en.text: Extract features with aeon, then feed them to a sklearn classifier
say_en.note: Builds ROCKET features first, then trains.
